name: Waykeeper Sergeant
title: Sergeant of the Outpost
examine: The order's coat and the order's count. Keeps the fire, keeps the pen, keeps the road, and answers to the lamp before anyone standing in its light.
lines: This post holds its miles by one lamp and the rota. Both are kept.
The pen is not for sleeping. The fire is free. The road is walked at dusk and at dawn and that is the whole of it.
Report what you saw. A count, not a story. The order writes down counts.
